variants.when: R1T (owner's guide for early-2024 software); no reset step
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb placard.
Drive above about 18 mph; it can take up to 10 minutes before the driver display shows the pressures again.
Check the pressures on the driver display. The low pressure warning should clear once all tires read correctly.
variants.note: A tire pressure light that flashes for about a minute and then stays on is a system fault for Rivian service.

notes: Rivian vehicles are electric, so there is no oil change reminder. The tire pressure system learns new pressures while driving, with nothing to reset.
